slot_scores.name: earnings_definition
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize the total amount of money you have at the end of the three-year horizon (i.e., at the end of year 3)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize total money at the end of year 3, which clarifies the calculation basis of 'earnings' as final wealth rather than net profit.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot (H1, P2) was resolved by turn 5, but the agent continued asking many repetitive and low-value questions through turn 30 without entering READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent successfully clarified the earnings definition and other modeling details, but then engaged in excessive repetitive questioning after all relevant hidden slots were resolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
